description:
An ultimate internet/network control, security and statistical tool for Windows.

NetLimiter in an ultimate internet/network control, security and statistical tool for Windows.
Use it to manage bandwidth of individual applications, monitor data coming to and out of your machine in real-time, block unwanted intruders, analyze network problems and much more...
This release brings mainly compatibility updates. There are many new versions of libraries and frameworks. We faced problems with signature certificate (very important security feature) which was caused by Microsoft's internal issues snd caused a lot of delay since last release. We apologise for that and since now, the updates should be more frequent. Thanks for you patience.
Note: We were forced to use a new signing certificate and it causes a warning popup window* to rarely appear while starting the installation. This popup should disappear soon. It constains information about the certificate (owned by our company "Locktime Software"). It is safe to Run and continue the installation.

New features
- Traffic chart improvents (browsing through points etc.).
- Tray icon widget improvements.
Fixed bugs
- Many minor fixes.
